import subprocess, time, sys
tie_in = b"Banana! APPLE? banana, apple; Cherry CHERRY cherry.\n123 d e f g h i j k l m"
tie_out = subprocess.check_output(["python3", "wf.py"], input=tie_in).decode()
if not tie_out.startswith("cherry 3\napple 2\nbanana 2\nd 1\ne 1\n"):
    print(0); sys.exit(0)
exp = open("expected.txt", "rb").read()
t0 = time.perf_counter()
with open("input.txt", "rb") as f:
    out = subprocess.check_output(["python3", "wf.py"], stdin=f)
dt = time.perf_counter() - t0
if out != exp:
    print(0); sys.exit(0)
print(f"{20.0 / dt:.2f}")
'
